mapper.sql: SELECT audit_id::text, scope, tenant_id::text, resource_kind, resource_id, resource_name, event_type, from_version, to_version, from_state, to_state, before_config::text, after_config::text, diff_summary::text, request_id::text, release_id, operator_id, reason, created_at FROM cap_audit_log
mapper.select: INSERT INTO cap_audit_log (audit_id, scope, tenant_id, resource_kind, resource_id, resource_name, event_type, from_version, to_version, from_state, to_state, before_config, after_config, diff_summary, request_id, release_id, operator_id, reason, created_at) VALUES (#{auditId}, #{scope}, #{tenantId}::uuid, #{resourceKind}, #{resourceId}, #{resourceName}, #{eventType}, #{fromVersion}, #{toVersion}, #{fromState}, #{toState}, #{beforeConfig}::jsonb, #{afterConfig}::jsonb, #{diffSummary}::jsonb, #{requestId}, #{releaseId}, #{operatorId}, #{reason}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, now())) RETURNING created_at
